description:
Inventory taken 2026-07-27 on the maintainer's Windows box. 120 test targets outside the two vendored forks: 3 red, ~2900 green. None caused by that session's work. Filed so this is not rediscovered every time.

TWO MECHANICAL TRAPS FIRST, both cost real time:
* 'cargo test --workspace' STOPS at the first failing crate, so everything after kmux alphabetically silently never runs. Use --no-fail-fast.
* Do NOT pipe cargo through 'Select-Object -First N' in PowerShell: it closes the pipe and KILLS cargo mid-run, which looks exactly like a short passing run. Cost two bogus results in one session.

THE FAILURES, all environmental:
* kvim termemu::* / ui::app::* / lsp::install::* / editor::shell / gf (~17) — PTY, real-terminal and installed-binary assumptions.
* kmux (4 targets, ~6 tests) — 'ConPTY executable not found on PATH: pwsh.exe' (PowerShell 7 not installed), Windows daemon spawn, mouse-border resize. queued_background_if_shell_... is FLAKY: failed one run, passed the next. Same family as bd-2wo.
* kopi-beans (~11) — tombstone should-panics, symlink export (Windows symlinks need privilege), WAL executor.
* providers::csharp::compile_remove_globs_exclude_matching_sources — 'Excluded\**\*.cs' treats backslash as a glob separator on Windows.
* providers::python::a_non_executable_file_does_not_satisfy_detection — Windows has no executable bit, so everything looks executable.
* providers::rust_analyzer::collects_symbols_* — rust-analyzer times out; it stood down here ('project too big for full analysis on this device').

The kopitiam-semantic lsp_types failures are NOT in this bucket — that one is a real bug, bd-e12.

WANTED: #[cfg]-gate or environment-guard these so a stock Windows box can be green, and a genuine regression is visible instead of buried in expected noise. Worked example landed this session: kvim's an_unreadable_directory_renders_an_honest_error_row used std::os::unix ungated, which did not skip on Windows — it failed to COMPILE, taking the whole --all-targets build down. Now #[cfg(unix)].

notes.author: fifad@Teddy-Thinkpad
notes.content: PARTLY FIXED, and the inventory in this bead was WRONG about two of them. kopitiam-semantic is now fully green on Windows (147 passed, 0 failed) - see commit 107e0cf320. Two of the three were not environment noise at all, they were real cross-platform production bugs: (1) glob_matches normalized the PATTERN's backslashes but not the PATH's, so MSBuild <Compile Remove> exclusions silently did nothing on Windows - the platform where .csproj files mostly live; (2) is_executable_file returned true for EVERY file off-Unix, so a text file named pylsp on PATH was detected as a language server and handed to Command::spawn. Only the third (rust-analyzer indexing a 40-crate workspace) was genuinely environmental, and it now skips on TIMEOUT specifically while every other error still fails, so a real provider break cannot hide behind the guard. bd-klf (gguf_tokenizer vendor absence) also fixed and closed. REMAINING under this bead: the 10 kvim failures, all pty/ConPTY, plus the kopi-beans and kmux ones in the vendored forks. The kvim ones are blocked on ConPTY not working on this box at all - see bd-hyk, which also carries a proposed (unapplied, unverifiable) fix for a real ':term' bug found while investigating. LESSON worth keeping: 'these tests fail on Windows' is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis. Two of three here were the code being wrong, not the environment.

title: Workspace suite cannot go green on a stock Windows box: ~28 environment-dependent tests
